headline: Sensex and Nifty Crash Amid 24-Year High US Bond Yields; Rs 9 Lakh Crore Wiped Out

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: US 10-year bond yields reaching a 24-year high, rattling global markets
Massive en-masse selling of Indian stocks by foreign investors
Energy shocks fueling bets for further global interest rate hikes
Concerns over rising oil prices and global rate hike cycles sparking outflows
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty are heading for their longest weekly losing run in 25 years
The Sensex slumped over 1,000 points in a single session, wiping out massive investor wealth
Nifty Auto index fell over 4% as major auto stocks faced selling pressure
Multiple companies including Inox Air Products and Anarock filed IPO papers despite market volatility
summary: Indian markets are experiencing a severe downturn with the Sensex and Nifty on track for their worst losing streak in 25 years, driven by record-high US bond yields and heavy FII selling. Over Rs 9 lakh crore in investor wealth was wiped out as the Sensex plunged over 1,000 points before seeing a minor recovery. Despite the broader market crash, primary market activity continues with several large IPO filings from Inox Air Products and Anarock.
